title: 第十三章 无底洞的李洛
content_zh:
怀着激动的心，李洛一夜未眠。
清晨，房间的阁楼上，李洛揉了揉沉重的眼皮，眼神却有些遗憾的望着面前的檀木箱子。
其中还剩下将近一半左右的灵水奇光未曾用完。
李洛发现他还是忽略了一点，虽然他自身空相，并不担心灵水奇光中杂质的侵蚀，但是...吸收一支灵水奇光，却是需要时间的，而他也不可能将几十支灵水奇光混杂在一起直接使用，那样相互间干扰，反而会引得灵水奇光失效。
所以一晚上下来，他只是吸收了二十七支灵水奇光。
当然，如果这个只是被外人知晓的话，恐怕会直接认为李洛已经疯了...因为他们从未听说过，竟然有人敢这么玩...
一夜吸收二十七支灵水奇光，那其中所蕴含的杂质堆积起来，恐怕要不了多久，就会使其相宫封闭。
一般来说，只有那种穷途末路之人，才会选择这种破釜沉舟近乎疯狂的举动。
那真的就是不成功便成仁了。
“不过，效果倒是不错...”
李洛眼中遗憾持续了一会便是散去，继而眼光变得明亮起来，因为在他的感知中，自身那第一道相宫，光芒比起昨天，已是更为的纯澈，这甚至连带着其中流淌的相力，都是变得雄浑精纯了一分。
按照这种进度，李洛稍微估算了一下，如果他想要将自身这“水光相”提升到五品，或许还需要将近一百多支的四品灵水奇光。
这样算的话，李洛从四品提升到五品相，大概会消耗掉将近二十万枚天量金。
这个数额，李洛其实是能够接受的，可是...当他再以此类推往后的晋升时，就整个人都有些不好了。
因为五品相后，那些五品灵水奇光的价格将会成倍的递增，而相性品阶的晋升也会更为的艰难。
那岂不是，五品到六品，就得消耗掉近百万枚的天量金？
六品到七品...就是数百万？
再往后呢？
一时间，李洛突然有点窒息了，他虽然不怎么管事，但也知道，整个洛岚府一年的各种商会，产业的收入，也不过是数百万枚天量金左右。
他把洛岚府生吞活剥了，恐怕都很难提供出让他晋升到八品将要消耗的天量金吧？

这所谓的后天之相...简直就是一个无底洞啊！
李洛揉了揉眉心，老爹老娘给他留下的洛岚府，未来恐怕还真是养不起他这个败家仔...
“不过如果以后我能够自己炼制灵水奇光的话，倒是可以省不少。”
李洛想起了他的水光相，从某种意义来说，这是独属于他的优势，如果他能够发挥好这一点，他未来炼制出来的灵水奇光，恐怕会是市面上独一份的，这么来看，学习淬相术，也得提上日程了。
“看来老爹老娘也想到了这一点...所以才让我成为淬相师，免得到时候洛岚府直接被我吃垮了。”李洛感叹一声，再度感到自家老爹老娘的深谋远虑。
李洛最终还是没敢继续去想这个问题，反正至少在六品之前，他应该还是能够勉强支撑的，至于后面情况，就到时候再看吧。
于是他摇摇头，直接回了卧室，倒头休息去了。
在接下来的两天中，李洛便是开启了爆肝模式，白日修炼“沧澜冥想图”，直到达到极致后，便是修行两个小时的相术，然后开始服用灵水奇光提升相性品阶。
而这全力修炼，效果也不错，他的相力等级迅速的提升到了第四印，自身的四品水光相，也是在变得越来越精纯。
这个时候李洛感觉没有什么能够阻挡他的进步。
直到灵水奇光的告竭。
老宅，一间账房中。
蔡薇身穿长裙的坐在桌前，身姿窈窕，胸前弧度颇有些波涛汹涌，而此时的她，那美丽的鹅蛋脸上，却是微蹙着柳眉的看着面前的一些账本。
“古管事，今年洛岚府在天蜀郡的收入，似乎是减得有些厉害。”蔡薇目光从账本中抬起，看着面前的数位管事。
那被称为古管事的中年男子苦笑着点点头，道：“大管事说的没错，洛岚府在天蜀郡共有九家商会，十八处矿产，药产...只是因为府内的变故，这一年中，天蜀郡那三家对我们蚕食得有些紧，其中又以宋家为最，九家商会中，有两家都是在今年被宋家以各种手段打散，最后又被其吞了下去。”
蔡薇美目有些冷冽，洛岚府自天蜀郡南风城发家，此后便是以极为惊人的速度崛起为大夏国五大府之一。
不过天蜀郡中，除了洛岚府外，还有着三大家的存在，虽说在整体规模上，这三家无法与完整的洛岚府相比，但在这天蜀郡内，他们也算是老牌势力，根深蒂固，底蕴颇深。
当年两位家主尚在时，洛岚府如日中天，这三家倒是极为的乖觉，一个个听话得很，可没想到如今两位家主一失踪，他们便是趁着洛岚府内忧外患，开始上跳下窜起来。
蔡薇之前就听姜青娥说过，这三家的背后，说不得便是有着其他顶尖势力的指示，无非便是不断的试探如今洛岚府的虚实。
天蜀郡三家，宋家，贝家，蒂法家，其中又以宋家实力最强，同时这两年手脚也最多，不断的以各种手段染指，打压，侵吞洛岚府在天蜀郡的商会，产业。

而要知道这宋家的家主在前些年，可是年年都会提着年礼登门拜访的。
这前后的转变，当真是宛如唱戏般。
不过蔡薇经历了不少，自然也不是心怀幼稚，洛岚府的存在本就挤压了三大家的利益，如今对方见洛岚府内忧外患，想要想办法踩几脚也不可能说人家没道义，只是立场不同，自然要视对方如仇寇。
但是...如今洛岚府，可真是腾不出多余的力量来这天蜀郡救火，毕竟其他地方，处处都需要支援，再加上那裴昊的存在...更是引得洛岚府雪上加霜。
蔡薇沉默了片刻，最终果断的道：“一些无法扭转盈亏的商会，暂时就直接关闭吧，没必要和对方纠缠。”
一时的隐忍是必须的，只要等到洛岚府稳定下来，到时候这三家吃了多少，都得老老实实的吐出来。
听到她下了决定，下面的几位管事也是应了下来，因为他们也明白如今洛岚府在天蜀郡的情况，的确是有些相形见绌。
而在此时，突然有人敲响了房门，蔡薇说了一声请进，房门被推开，只见得李洛走了进来。
那几名管事见状，连忙行礼。
李洛摆了摆手，蔡薇则是让他们先行退下去，美目投向前者，道：“少府主有什么事情吗？”
李洛轻咳了一声，笑道：“的确是有点小事要麻烦蔡薇姐。”
蔡薇姐狭长而略带妩媚的美目眨了眨，隐隐的感觉到一些不安，但还是道：“何事？”
李洛露出温和的笑容，道：“也不是其他的事情，就是那四品的灵水奇光，之前的五十份消耗完了，所以想麻烦蔡薇姐再帮我采购一百份。”
蔡薇白皙光滑的鹅蛋脸上的神情在此时一点点的凝固起来，她美目瞪圆的盯着李洛，饱满胸前都是在微微起伏。
“再采购一百份？四品灵水奇光？”
蔡薇双手都是忍不住的握紧了，她这才管理洛岚府在天蜀郡的财务几天？难道就要直接破产了吗？
于是她忍了又忍，最终忍不了了，一巴掌拍在桌子上，柳眉倒竖。
“李洛，你是不是不想让老娘干了啊？”
content_en:
With excitement in his heart, Li Luo stayed up all night.
In the early morning, in the attic of the room, Li Luo rubbed his heavy eyelids, but looked at the sandalwood box in front of him with regret.
There is still nearly half of the spiritual water and strange light left that has not been used up.
Li Luo found that he had overlooked one point. Although he was in the empty phase and was not worried about the erosion of impurities in the spiritual water strange light, but... it took time to absorb one spiritual water strange light, and he could not mix dozens of spiritual water strange lights together and use them directly. If they interfered with each other, it would cause the spiritual water strange light to fail.
So in one night, he only absorbed twenty-seven magical lights of spiritual water.
Of course, if this was only known to outsiders, they would probably think that Li Luo was crazy... because they had never heard of anyone daring to play like this...
After absorbing the strange light of twenty-seven spiritual waters in one night, the impurities contained in it will accumulate, and I am afraid that it will not be long before the palace is closed.
Generally speaking, only those who are at the end of their rope would choose this desperate and almost crazy move.
That really means success or failure.
"However, the effect is quite good..."
The regret in Li Luo's eyes lasted for a while and then dissipated, and then his eyes became brighter, because in his perception, the light of his first phase palace was purer than yesterday, and even the phase force flowing in it became more powerful and pure.
Based on this progress, Li Luo made some estimates. If he wanted to upgrade his "water light phase" to the fifth level, he might need nearly a hundred fourth-level spiritual water miraculous lights.
Calculating this way, Li Luo's promotion from the fourth level to the fifth level will probably consume nearly 200,000 heavenly gold.
This amount was actually acceptable to Li Luo, but... when he continued to be promoted in this way, his whole person felt a little bad.
Because after the fifth-grade phase, the price of those fifth-grade spiritual water and strange light will increase exponentially, and the promotion of the phase level will be more difficult.
Wouldn't that mean that from fifth to sixth grade, nearly a million gold would have to be consumed?
Rank six to seven...that's millions?
What next?
For a moment, Li Luo suddenly felt a little suffocated. Although he didn't take care of things very much, he also knew that the annual income of various chambers of commerce and industries in the entire Luo Lan Mansion was only about a few million pieces of gold.
He devoured the Luo Lan Mansion alive, so it would be difficult for him to provide the amount of gold that would be consumed to promote him to the eighth level, right?
This so-called acquired appearance... is simply a bottomless pit!
Li Luo rubbed his eyebrows. The Luo Lan Mansion left by his parents would probably not be able to support a prodigal like him in the future...
"But if I can refine the spiritual water and strange light myself in the future, I can save a lot."
Li Luo thought of his water-light phase. In a sense, this was his unique advantage. If he could make good use of this, the spiritual water and strange light he would refine in the future would probably be the only one on the market. From this point of view, learning the phase-quenching technique must also be put on the agenda.
"It seems that my father and mother have also thought of this... That's why they asked me to become a physiognomist, so that the Luo Lan Mansion will not be directly destroyed by me." Li Luo sighed, once again feeling the foresight of his father and mother.
In the end, Li Luo didn't dare to continue thinking about this problem. Anyway, at least before the sixth level, he should be able to barely support it. As for the subsequent situation, we will see when the time comes.
So he shook his head, went directly back to the bedroom, and went to rest.
In the next two days, Li Luo turned on the liver-exploding mode and practiced the "Canglan Meditation Diagram" during the day. After reaching the extreme, he practiced physiognomy for two hours, and then began to take spiritual water and strange light to improve his physiognomy level.
And this full-strength cultivation has good results. His phase power, etc.The level was quickly promoted to the fourth seal, and his own fourth-grade water-light phase was becoming more and more pure.
At this time, Li Luo felt that nothing could stop his progress.
Until the spiritual water and strange light are exhausted.
In an old house, in a counting room.
Cai Wei was sitting at the table in a long skirt, with a slim figure and a rather rough curve in her chest. At this time, on her beautiful oval face, she was looking at some account books in front of her with a slight frown.
"Steward Gu, Luo Lan Mansion's income in Tianshu County seems to have dropped a bit this year." Cai Wei raised her eyes from the account book and looked at the several stewards in front of her.
The middle-aged man known as the Gu Steward smiled bitterly and nodded, saying: "The Chief Steward is right. Luolan Mansion has nine chambers of commerce in Tianshu County, eighteen mines, and pharmaceutical products... Just because of changes in the mansion, the three families in Tianshu County have been encroaching on us a little bit this year, and the Song family is the most important among them. Two of the nine chambers of commerce were broken up by the Song family this year using various means, and were eventually swallowed up by them."
Cai Wei's beautiful eyes were a bit cold. Luolan Mansion made its fortune from Nanfeng City in Tianshu County. Since then, it has risen to become one of the five major mansions in Daxia Kingdom at an astonishing speed.
However, in Tianshu County, in addition to Luolan Mansion, there are three other major families. Although these three families cannot be compared with the complete Luolan Mansion in terms of overall scale, they are also considered established forces in Tianshu County, with deep roots and deep foundation.
When the two family heads were still alive, Luo Lan Mansion was at its peak. These three families were extremely well-behaved and obedient to each other. However, they did not expect that as soon as the two family heads disappeared, they took advantage of the internal and external troubles in Luo Lan Mansion and began to jump up and down.
Cai Wei had heard Jiang Qing'e say before that behind these three families, there might be instructions from other top forces, but they were just constantly testing the reality of Luo Lan Mansion.
There are three families in Tianshu County, the Song family, the Bei family, and the Tifa family. Among them, the Song family is the strongest and has the most hands and feet in the past two years. They have constantly used various means to interfere, suppress, and embezzle the Luolan House's chamber of commerce and industry in Tianshu County.
And you must know that in the past few years, the head of the Song family would come to visit every year with new year's gifts.
The transformation before and after is really like singing.
However, Cai Wei has been through a lot, and naturally she is not naive. The existence of the Luo Lan Mansion has already squeezed the interests of the three families. Now that the other party has seen the internal and external troubles in the Luo Lan Mansion, it is impossible to say that they are unjust even if they want to find ways to step on them. It is just that they have different stances, so naturally they will treat each other as enemies.
But... now Luo Lan Mansion really can't spare any extra energy to put out the fire in Tianshu County. After all, other places need support everywhere, and the presence of Pei Hao... makes Luo Lan Mansion even worse.
Cai Wei was silent for a moment, and finally said decisively: "Some chambers of commerce that cannot reverse their profits and losses should be closed down for the time being. There is no need to entangle with each other."
Temporary forbearance is necessary. As long as Luo Lan Mansion stabilizes, these three families will have to spit out whatever they have eaten.
After hearing her decision, the following stewards also agreed, because they also understood that the current situation of Luolan Mansion in Tianshu County was indeed somewhat dwarfed by comparison.
At this moment, someone suddenly knocked on the door. Cai Wei said, "Come in." The door was pushed open, and Li Luo walked in.
When the stewards saw this, they quickly saluted.
Li Luo waved his hand, and Cai Wei asked them to retreat first. She turned her beautiful eyes to the former and said, "What can I do for you, Young Master?"
Li Luo coughed lightly and said with a smile: "It is indeed a little thing to trouble Sister Cai Wei."
Sister Cai Wei blinked her narrow and slightly charming eyes, feeling vaguely uneasy, but still said: "What's the matter?"
Li Luo showed a gentle smile and said: "It's not other things, it's the fourth-grade spiritual water and the strange light, the previous fiftyThe servings have been used up, so I would like to ask Sister Cai Wei to help me purchase another hundred servings. "
The expression on Cai Wei's fair and smooth oval face solidified little by little at this moment. She stared at Li Luo with her beautiful eyes wide open, her plump chest rising and falling slightly.
“Buy another hundred copies? Fourth-grade spiritual water and strange light? "
Cai Wei couldn't help clenching her hands. How many days had she been managing Luolan Mansion's finances in Tianshu County? Is it going to go bankrupt directly?
So she endured it again and again, and finally couldn't bear it anymore. She slapped her hand on the table and raised her eyebrows.
"Li Luo, don't you want me to do this? "
